code.text: COAG
PANEL.MICRO

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild neutropenia. There is evidence of inflammation (elevated CRP, ferritin, LDH, D-dimer), mild liver enzyme elevation, and monocytosis/basophilia. COVID-19 PCR is negative. Findings suggest a systemic inflammatory response, possible bone marrow suppression or infiltration, and mild hepatic involvement. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
